# Obserc: Personal Safety App

> Your world. Shared & Secured.

Obserc is a proactive personal safety app for iOS that keeps users quietly connected to the people who matter most. Instead of waiting for an emergency to happen, Obserc creates a live safety net around the user before anything goes wrong. 

## App Store Download
- iOS App Store: https://apps.apple.com/ca/app/obserc/id6759740570

## Target Audience
Students, young women, friends, families, and drivers who want to share safety awareness without the noise of a standard group chat.

## Core Features
- **Circles:** Private groups of trusted people who share safety awareness.
- **Status Tab:** The home base for checking safety state, sending check-ins, and nudging friends.
- **SOS Beacon:** A one-tap urgent alert that sends live location to the user's circle. Includes a "Critical SOS" override (hold for 3 seconds) for immediate danger.
- **Night Out Mode:** A dedicated nightlife safety mode featuring "Find My Squad" radar, an "I Feel Off" button, Safety Call (fake phone call to escape awkward situations), and Morning After Reports.
- **Circle Map:** Real-time location sharing map with "Ghost Mode" for temporary, absolute privacy.
- **Obserc Drive:** Passive driving safety monitoring that alerts circles upon safe arrival and detects hard braking events, keeping data strictly private from insurers.
- **Streaks:** A daily habit-building system (Firewood to Phoenix) rewarding regular check-ins.
